1. College Assignment Submission Tracker
Scenario:
A college department struggles to track assignment submissions across multiple
subjects. Faculty want a dashboard to view submitted, pending, and late
assignments.
Key Features:
 Add assignment (title, subject, due date)
 Mark submission status (Submitted / Pending / Late)
 Filter by subject
 Dashboard summary (counts)
